none: PAS LANCUM-868607: Roman copper alloy coin
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CONSTANTINVS AVG ; R/ VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP VOT P R PLN

A copper alloy nummus of Constantine I dating to the period AD 319 to 320 (Reece Period 16). Reverse type VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP, Two Victories holding shield inscribed VOT PR. Cf RIC 7 (London), 158. Obverse inscription IMP CONSTANTINVS AVG; reverse inscription VICTORIAE LAETAE PRINC PERP VOT P R PLN. The diameter is 19mm and the weight is 2.2g
